# BayesSMCM

```{=html}

[![R-CMD-check](https://github.com/fatihki/BayesSMCM)](https://github.com/fatihki/BayesSMCM/actions)
```

[![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-green.svg)](https://opensource.org/licenses/MIT)

This is an R package **BayesSMCM** implementing Bayesian hierarchical modeling for the semiparametric mixture cure model (SMCM), which accommodates both the inclusion and exclusion of a frailty component [Kızılaslan F and Vitelli V, 2025](https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.08173).

## Installation

Install the latest development version from [GitHub](https://github.com/fatihki/BayesSMCM)

```{r include=FALSE}
#install.packages("remotes")
```
